description: Fetch full detail for a service alert (situation) by ID. Returns the summary, description, reason (e.g. detour, construction), affected stops and routes, consequence description, and active time windows. Situation IDs appear in onebusaway_get_arrivals responses under situationIds and situations[].id.

situationId.description: Situation/alert ID from onebusaway_get_arrivals (situations[].id or arrivals[].situationIds[]).

name: onebusaway_get_alert

activeWindows.description: Time windows when this alert is active.

items.description: A time window during which this alert is active.

from.description: Start of active window as Unix milliseconds, if known.

to.description: End of active window as Unix milliseconds, if known.

affects.description: Stops, routes, trips, or agencies affected by this alert.

items.description: An entity affected by this alert.

agencyId.description: Affected agency ID, if scoped to an agency.

routeId.description: Affected route ID, if scoped to a route.

stopId.description: Affected stop ID, if scoped to a stop.

tripId.description: Affected trip ID, if scoped to a trip.

consequenceMessage.description: Human-readable consequence description (e.g. "Detour in effect"), or null.

diversionStopIds.description: Stop IDs on the diversion path, when condition is "detour".

description.description: Longer description of the alert, or null.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `situation_not_found`: Situation ID does not exist on this instance. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

reason.description: Reason code from TPEG: equipmentReason, environmentReason, personnelReason, miscellaneousReason, securityAlert. Null when not provided.

severity.description: Severity level as reported by the agency, or null.

summary.description: Short summary of the service alert.

url.description: URL for more information about this alert, or null.

title: Get Service Alert Detail
